summary: Verified new withdrawal→live-chat + top-up-via-chat flow. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass (deposit/info receiver='support', /api/chats support+deposit still work with deposit receiver_nick='Поддержка', /api/chats kind='withdrawal' returns 401 for guest and 201 for authed user with withdrawal_request user msg and 'Заявка на вывод принята' system msg, /api/skins/withdraw creates pending w/d). Frontend: profile withdraw button styled dark-gold, clicking inventory item→withdraw opens live chat with correct msg, no 'support-dialog'/ysrent1 anywhere, profile-withdrawal-instructions opens chat, top-up modal tab labelled 'Деньги' (RU), rub-method-sbp+rub-method-card tiles present, rub-quick-100+rub-pay-button creates chat msg 'Хочу пополнить баланс через СБП на 100 ₽ (≈ 200 RAP)' and closes modal, card-support-button creates 'Хочу пополнить баланс банковской картой (Visa / Mastercard)' msg and closes modal. Only quirk: switching lang via localStorage+reload did not swap tab label to 'Money' in one run (react state not reloaded via localStorage change alone); i18n dictionary has both 'Деньги' and 'Money' correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py chats_create: For kind='withdrawal', the auth check (`profile.registered`) is performed AFTER `chat.create_chat` runs. If a guest calls it, the chat is created first, then 401 raised, leaving an orphan open support chat in DB. Recommend moving the registration check above create_chat to prevent orphan chats. (Currently still returns 401 to the client so functionally OK, but pollutes chats collection.)

chats_create returns kind='support' in the chat record even when payload.kind was 'deposit' or 'withdrawal' — chat kind is fixed to 'support' inside create_chat. This is by design (single chat per user) but the API contract is a bit surprising. Consider documenting or storing latest 'action' on the chat.
